subject: Interim OKR readout — requests to unblock infra gating and scope adjustments
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-10-03T08:07:00-07:00
Subject: Interim OKR readout — requests to unblock infra gating and scope adjustments

Team —

Quick mid-cycle readout and explicit asks to keep our Serving & Routing OKRs on track. TL;DR: product progress is fine, but a set of infra gating items (KV cache persistence, new kernel rollout, and regional capacity mapping) are holding back the QA pass for model variant swaps. Without these unblocked we should formally re-scope the external-facing rollout to a single-region pilot.

Status highlights:
- Serving runtime: feature-complete for model-swap flow; integration tests passing 86% (see attached heatmap).
- Routing & fallback: policy engine changes merged; need infra validation before can enable multi-variant fallback.
- Cost/throughput: current numbers indicate +17% token throughput gains on test bench once new kernels land.

Blocking asks (actionable, with proposed owners & dates):
1) KV cache persistence validation — owner: Connor — test sign-off by 2026-10-07 (INF-3421).
2) Kernel rollout smoke tests on p4d-prod — owner: Stephanie/Infra — finish by 2026-10-09.
3) Capacity mapping for EU fallbacks — owner: Marissa — provide target region list and SLA exceptions by 2026-10-08.

If any of the above dates are optimistic, I propose we re-scope the external rollout to a single-region (us-west) pilot and delay multi-region ramp until the infra gating is closed. That needs leadership sign-off by COB 2026-10-05 so we can update Acme's expectations.

Attachments: Q3-OKR-status-heatmap.pdf (high-level progress), infra-blockers-tracker.xlsx (linked to INF-3421).

Next steps: can each owner reply inline with firm commit or realistic slip? I'll consolidate answers and send a final readout to Lauren and the exec thread.

Thanks —
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Serving Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interim OKR readout — requests to unblock infra gating and scope adjustments

Karthik — thanks for the clear ask and the attachments. Quick responses inline: 

- KV cache persistence: I can deprioritize a non-blocking telemetry job and spare a SWE for the 10/05 smoke window; I expect sign-off on 10/07 is achievable if Connor doesn't hit an unexpected blocker.
- Kernel rollout: Stephanie, is the p4d-prod window still available 10/08–10/09? If not, we need to move to 10/12.
- EU capacity mapping: I have a conversation with Cloud Ops scheduled this week; will aim to deliver the region list + SLA exceptions by 10/08 EOD.

If we need to take the single-region pilot approach, I support that as a conservative path. Recommend we also prepare a short customer note for Acme in case of scope shift.

Marissa
VP, Product
Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interim OKR readout — requests to unblock infra gating and scope adjustments

Karthik / Marissa — attaching the infra-blockers-tracker.xlsx with per-item status (row per INF ticket). Short notes:
- KV cache persistence: main risk is an edge-case eviction race; I have a repro and a patch in review. If the patch lands today, I can run the validation job on 10/06 and sign off 10/07.
- I listed a fallback plan (sheet:FallbackPlan) that would allow single-region rollout with a feature flag for KV persistence; feature flagging adds ~48 hours to rollout but keeps customers on the table.

Attachment: infra-blockers-tracker.xlsx

Connor
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
From: Sarah Holt <sarah.holt@acmecorp.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T15:36:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interim OKR readout — requests to unblock infra gating and scope adjustments

Thanks for the update, Karthik. Acme's timeline is flexible within Q4 but we'd prefer a staged rollout rather than an indefinite delay. Two asks from our side: 
1) Can you confirm which features would be available in a single-region pilot vs the multi-region plan?
2) Can you schedule a 30-minute sync next week with Product + Eng to walk the pilot plan and rollback criteria?

Availability: I have 10/06 between 9–11 PT or 10/08 after 1 PT. If you send a calendar invite with the agenda, we'll bring our CloudOps contact.

—Sarah
Sarah Holt
Head of AI Products, Acme Corp
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Holt <sarah.holt@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T15:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interim OKR readout — requests to unblock infra gating and scope adjustments

Thanks for the quick turnarounds, everyone. Consolidated commitments and the decision path below — please treat as final unless you notify me by EOD 2026-10-06.

Decisions: 
- We will proceed with a single-region (us-west) external pilot target, with a feature-flagged path for KV persistence. Multi-region ramp will be gated on the kernel rollout smoke tests and EU capacity mapping (see INF-3421).

Committed dates: 
- Connor: KV persistence validation & sign-off — 2026-10-07 (owner confirmed).
- Stephanie: kernel rollout smoke on p4d-prod — 2026-10-09 (confirming maintenance window with Infra now).
- Marissa: EU region list + SLA exception list — 2026-10-08 EOD.

Customer communication: I'll draft a short note to Acme with the pilot scope and rollback criteria today and send a calendar invite for 10/06 10:00–10:30 PT (Karthik/Marissa/Connor/Acme + CloudOps). Sarah — sending the invite now.

Links & artifacts: tracker + heatmap attached; full readout in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cQ3OKRreadout. Jira: INF-3421.

If anything changes, call me out immediately. Thanks for moving fast on this — getting the infra gate closed keeps the OKR trajectory intact without a full rescope.

—Karthik
